summary: Robert Evans, Katy Stoll and Cody Johnston continue reading Ben Shapiro's 2016 novel True Allegiance, criticising its racist Detroit crack-dealer plot, a staged police killing of a Black child, border cartel scares and a Taliban-held Kabul.
